description: register.tsx (the "modules" entry above): the plan band, the Plan pane, the plan event relay, the time stamp on every prompt and tool call, the registry's event text for a plan-connected session (session start, resume, compaction, every sub-agent) and the restart notice, as native function hooks, tested by `claude plugin test danxbot` and validated by `claude plugin validate danxbot` before every publish (publish.sh needs the claude CLI: CLAUDE_BIN). Activity, background-work, and ready-cards reports run as function hooks, all through danxbot_api calls in register.tsx. Which danx-dashboard-mcp version runs: the server launcher (dashboard-mcp-server.mjs) installs and refreshes it (DX-4321).
